skill.summary: [QwenCloud] Manage account auth and query usage/billing. Use for: login, logout, check usage, view billing, free tier quota, coding plan status, pay-as-you-g...

latestVersion.changelog:
**Major update: Migrates skill to require the official QwenCloud CLI; all Python scripts removed.**

- Replaces all custom scripts with the official `qwencloud` CLI (Node.js-based).
- Updates all usage, authentication, and command examples to use the new CLI syntax.
- Skill now depends on external CLI; manual installation required (`npm install -g @qwencloud/qwencloud-cli`).
- Removes previous Python code, agent output parsing, and agent handling logic tied to custom scripts.
- Complete rewrite of authentication flow instructions, now matching CLI JSON event handling best practices.
